visual_brief.subject: Programmable code-review policy is joined to an inspectable but non-authoritative provenance trail
verified_context: GitHub added REST and GraphQL controls for Copilot code-review settings from enterprise policy down to repositories.
Attribution metadata can report review effort and the skills, MCP servers and custom instructions associated with a comment.
The metadata is first-party evidence and does not independently prove the model's reasoning or completeness.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: AI review becomes governable when its policy can be automated and its configuration trail can be inspected without being mistaken for certification.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A dark-metal review press is governed by three terracotta levers while an attached chain of distinct material links records the evidence trail.

candidate_notes.A: Selected. A substantial review press, three policy levers and an attached chain make governance and provenance visible without resembling software UI or claiming that the trail is proof.
candidate_notes.B: Constitution-compliant. The inspection gate and incoming control rods are clear, but the lined paper surface comes closer to imitating a code or document interface.
candidate_notes.C: Constitution-compliant. The opened seal is visually strong, though the provenance links are less legible at thumbnail scale than in A.

crop_review.article_desktop: The press, all three levers and the complete provenance chain remain visible across the wide hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered crop keeps the press and levers dominant while retaining the terracotta and gray provenance links.
crop_review.thumbnail: The press silhouette and terracotta controls remain legible at 320px; chain detail is supplementary.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate shares the tooling references' pale paper ground, charcoal constructed artifact, sparse terracotta controls and tactile print texture. It is more industrial and object-centered than the references, so Golden Reference Fit is scored at 85.
